test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The provision of Amendment of Constitution in the Constitution of India was adopted from the Constitution of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**South Africa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The provision of the Amendment of the Constitution in the Constitution of India was adopted from the Constitution of South Africa.**
 
• The election of members of the Rajya Sabha is also adopted from **South Africa.**
